target_audience: Nigerian/West African students and young adults

key_elements: Emoji-driven UI for low cognitive load
Soft teal/green primary with warm peach/cream neutrals

typography.strategy: Old Money Tech / Editorial Future twist for warmth

surface_strategies.solid_cards: bg-white border border-border shadow-sm rounded-2xl p-6

emoji_system.style: Apple-ish flat round cohesive set. Do not mix outline icons with emojis in the same logical group.
emoji_system.usage: Use extensively for categorisation, mood selection, and fast-action prompts to reduce cognitive load.

onboarding.layout: Centered bento grid or spacious vertical flow (p-8 to p-12).
onboarding.elements: Simplified copy, feature list using emojis (e.g. 🛡️ Anonymous, 💬 Real-time Chat), warm 'Welcome' H1 in Fraunces.
onboarding.background: Cream background (#FCFBF8) with soft floating subtle accent blobs if possible.

dashboard.mood_picker: Horizontal flex of 4-5 large emoji buttons (e.g. 😢 😐 😌 😃). Active state gets a soft secondary background and ring.
dashboard.stat_tiles: Glass cards, clean text, minimal borders.
dashboard.action_cards: Warmer cards (using secondary or muted backgrounds) with emoji headers.

mood_tracker.form: Centered giant animated emoji (text-8xl) that changes based on selection. Score display clearly below it. Generous padding.
mood_tracker.history_list: Clean list where the emoji serves as the leading avatar/icon.

chat.header: Clean, glassmorphism header. Warm welcome state ('Hi there, how are you feeling today?').
chat.prompts_grid: 2x2 grid of buttons below the welcome message. E.g., 'Feeling Anxious 🌪️', 'Need to vent 🗣️'. Buttons are glass or solid white with soft shadow.
chat.bubbles: Patient (User) bubbles: Primary colored (Soft Teal). Bot bubbles: Muted/White.

forum.pills: Topic selectors as rounded-full pills with emojis ('Anxiety 🌪️', 'Study Stress 📚').
forum.empty_state: Warm, illustrated or emoji-driven empty state ('Be the first to share 💛').
forum.post_detail: Spacious typography, Fraunces for post title, Inter for body.

appointments.counselor_cards: Soft styling, large avatar (rounded-xl), clear 'Book' button (Primary color).

motion_and_animations.philosophy: Smooth, calming, spring-based interactions. Nothing jarring or aggressive.

specs.page_enter: Fade in and subtle slide up (duration-500 ease-out)

rules.context: Rename 'patients' to 'users' everywhere in user-facing copy to reduce clinical anxiety.

images.description: African student smiling (warm, inviting, relatable for the target audience)
Professional African therapist/counselor engaging with a user
Calming nature sunlight (use for empty states, resource cards, or soft background overlays)

rules: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, emoji pickers) MUST have a data-testid attribute.
Do NOT alter existing auth/role logic data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the soft teal and warm cream palette using the exact HSL variables provided.
Use Fraunces (font-serif) for all Headings (H1, H2, H3) and Inter (font-sans) for body text.
Incorporate the 'glass_cards' strategy for dashboard tiles and panels to make the UI feel breathable and premium.
Ensure the Onboarding flows use the designated images and have a welcoming, spacious layout.
Implement the emoji-driven UI exactly as specified: giant animated emoji for Mood Tracker, 2x2 grid for Chat prompts, emoji pills for Forum topics, and emoji mood picker for the Dashboard.
Globally replace the term 'patient' with 'user' in all user-facing text.
Do NOT alter the underlying authentication or role-based logic.
